notes.title: Time to Sleigh in Our New Christmas Update!
notes.content:
Since you’ve all been so good this year, Santa has decided to visit post-apocalyptic Paris to bring the gift of a new game mode!

Unfortunately, he left some other presents lying around, and it’s up to you to ensure that the Assimilated don’t get their hands on them! Fight through the hordes, collect the gifts scattered around, bring them safely to the chimney, and survive for as long as you can. The more gifts you grab, the better chance you have of snagging better equipment!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39563592/022f0cb90f676bf62a3eb2058d1c55b38ec6069b.png[/img]

Do you think you’ll last ‘til Christmas morning?

We also have a sale coming up on January 22nd as well. It’s our way of giving back to our community that has made this awesome journey possible. Send your friends a copy of Project Terminus during the Steam Winter Sale with 25% off! Promo ends on January 5th.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39563592/46c89fad43e2dfd807971e47a1bc17ef43e90a50.png[/img]

If you’re having a white and lonely Christmas at the metro, come join us on [url=https://discord.gg/pYEUY5nHVE]Discord[/url] to find other players online.

notes.title: Patch Notes 2.2.7
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

We have heard your feedback and received your bug reports, and are happy to announce that we have released the following bug fixes in today’s patch.

Bug Fixes:
   - Fixed the reset of the player's position when dying two times in a row
   - Fixed the shop's electrical “one-way trip” chapter bug.
   - Deleted the invisible wall on the "one-way trip" Chapter
   - Repositioned the player to fix the playspace offset
   - Fixed the bad placement of the map editor menu. 
   - Fixed the nanite path on "the cruise" Chapter 

As always, we appreciate our community members who have reached out to report issues in the game. Please continue reporting any bugs that you may find along the way, as this will help us to continue to improve the overall experience of the game.

- Fixed the bad placement of the map editor menu.
- Fixed the nanite path on "the cruise" Chapter

notes.title: Update 2.2.5
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

We hear you and as promised, we have made some quality-of-life updates.

The update includes the following:

[b]Additions: [/b]
-Added text "Press A to skip" for each step of Onboarding.
-Show the onboarding screen of the map and the character of choice when the player decides to redo the onboarding.
-Better onboarding user interface.

[b]We have fixed the issues to these bugs:[/b]
-Unable to take an item from inventory with toggle grip mode.
-Can't pick up some objects with both hands: Rope, Jetski Handlebar, and Valve.
-The double notification obstructs vision at the time you discover the crank in the map "Bastille".
-Stuck behind the pallet jack in the lobby.
-In multiplayer, the jetski could not move on the map "The Cruise".

If you have found a bug or have feedback or suggestions, please join us on Discord.

Link: [url=https://discord.gg/pYEUY5nHVE]https://discord.gg/pYEUY5nHVE[/url]

notes.title: Horde Map Update: Prizes Awaits for the Most Points!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors,

We are excited to announce that we have launched a new Horde Mode that will feature new guns, wave-based survival gameplay, and worldwide leaderboards so you can see how you stack up to your fellow survivors!

Play with as many as 4 players at a time, provided with a Famas and a 50 Cal. for extra measure to help you survive for as long as you can. 

We have also made adjustments to the enemy AI for a much more enjoyable experience.

To celebrate the launch of Horde Mode, we will also be having a competition where we will give away 4 pieces of custom Project Terminus merch to the top team on the 4-player Horde Mode leaderboard! The event will run from October 27th to November 10th, so hurry up, and show us if you have what it takes to be the best team of survivors out there!

Join our Discord to look for fellow survivors to defeat the horde of assimilated.
Link: [url=https://discord.gg/b3n5q3TMqu]https://discord.gg/b3n5q3TMqu[/url]

Are you ready to defend yourself and survive? 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1437280/Project_Terminus_VR/

notes.title: Patch Notes: Version 2.1 Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello!

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Inventory saving is done at the end of each map in addition to being available at terminals.
[*] Help guides for the player in Chapter 10 - Part 2 - Catacombs.
[*] Improvement of scenes for the OneWayTrip chapter.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented you from using the crank when the bag was open next to it. 
[*] Players could have a visual indicating they were playing the demo of the game when they were not.
[*] During a multiplayer game, some player microphones could stop working when changing scenes.
[*] Texture glitches: some textures would appear pixelated at times.
[/list]
[b]Additional Changes:[/b]
We added the possibility of sideloading ad images for our other titles both in-game, and out of the game (main menu banner, brown prologue poster x2, in-game advertisement screen, in-game large poster). 

If you're looking for multiplayer matches, or would love to hear about recent updates and development, we invite you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/mH7p9uJevW]Discord[/url]. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1437280/Project_Terminus_VR/

The Casual-VR Team

notes.title: Act II Update !
notes.content:
Hey survivors!

Act II is finally there :)
Five new chapters for you to experience ! 
Will you discover new places ? Will you unravel new mysteries regarding the nanites ?

A big thanks to all our beta testers for their help.


Have a great day, see you in the streets!
